title: A World Space Week Pokémon × ESA Collaboration Has Launched
content:
The world is currently celebrating World Space Week. And as part of that celebration, The Pokémon Company and the European Space Agency (ESA) are launching the main part of their World Space Week collaboration: the Field Research and Wild Encounters Pokémon GO gameplay. Both gameplay events span from October 4 to October 10 at participating European museums.

During the Field Research event, Pokémon GO players who spin PokéStops at the collaboration museums will trigger World Space Week event-themed Field Research tasks. Upon completing those tasks, players will be rewarded with event-themed Pokémon; some will include special backgrounds. The Wild Encounter event increases a player’s chance of encountering select Pokémon in the skies around partner museums. These Pokémon include:

• Pikachu

• Blipbug

• Clefairy

• Elgyem

• Lunatone

• Magnemite

• Solrock

• Starmie

Participating collaboration museums include:

• ESA HQ (Paris, France)

• ESA ECSAT (Harwell, UK)

• ESA ESAC (Madrid, Spain)

• ESA ESEC (Redu, Belgium)

• ESA ESRIN (Frascati, Italy)

• ESA ESOC (Darmstadt, Germany)

• ESA ESTEC (Noordwijk, Netherlands)

Other participating museums include:

• Cité de l’espace – Toulouse, France

• Deutsches Museum – Nuremberg, Germany

• Euro Space Center – Transinne, Belgium

• Museu de les Ciències – València, Spain

• Science Museum – London, England

• Space Expo – Noordwijk, Netherlands

The Pokémon Company had previously announced the collaboration. It also features a longer-running Raids gameplay. That event will take place at collaborating museums from October 4, 2026, to April 30, 2027. Players who complete the Raids will have the chance to catch Astronaut Pikachu. Earlier this year, Pikachu spent 67 days onboard the International Space Station. French astronaut Sophie Adenot took the Pikachu plush to space. Pikachu completed over 1000 orbits in that time.

World Space Week is an annual celebration of space exploration that runs between October 4 and 10. The United Nations inaugurated World Space Week in 1999 to celebrate the launch of Sputnik 1 on October 4, 1957, and the Outer Space Treaty of October 10, 1967. This year’s theme is “Rocket Revolution,” which highlights the technologies that took humans to space.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime's 2nd Teaser Reveals More Cast, January Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Makoto Morishita 's The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop ( Sudachi no Maōjō ) manga presented on Tuesday the anime's second teaser promotional video, key visual, additional cast member, and January 2027 premiere on the Tokyo MX , MBS , BS11 , and other channels.

The anime's staff also presented a new character visual. The visual features two characters with previously announced cast members Reiji Kawashima as Murabito or Villager (center in image below) and Rumi Ōkubo as Mao (left). It also features Ash (right), the hero (voiced by Yōhei Azakami ) who once defeated the demon lord and saved the world.

Kodansha 's K MANGA service releases the manga in English and describes the story:

After the hero defeated the demon lord, the world is finally at peace... leaving the young Villager of Beginnerville in a bind! Without a demon lord to defeat, people have no need for potions and items...leaving Villager's item shop, The Nest, empty and lifeless. At this rate, Villager might have to close The Nest...! But then suddenly a mysterious girl appears and everything changes...

Jun Taira is directing the anime at project No.9 . Keiichirō Ōchi ( Adachi and Shimamura , The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten , Once Upon a Witch's Death ) is in charge of series scripts, and Katsuyuki Sato ( Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! , Plus-Sized Elf , My Friend's Little Sister Has It In for Me! ) is designing the characters.

Additional staff members incluide:

• Prop Design: Recommendation, Inc.

• Color Key Artist: Miyuki Satō

• Art Director/Art Setting: Hisato Shioda

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūta Katayama

• Editing: Akari Saitō

• Sound Director: Noboru Haraguchi

• Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion

• Music: Takurō Iga

• Music Production: Avex Pictures

• Animation Producer: Tomoji Kojiya

Morishita launched the manga in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine in October 2021. Kodansha will ship the 14th compiled book volume on October 16.

Morishita launched the IM: The Great Priest Imhotep manga in Square Enix 's Shonen Gangan magazine in January 2015 after first publishing a one-shot. Square Enix published the 11th and final volume in September 2018. Yen Press licensed the manga and released the 11th volume in English in February 2019.

title: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival Anime's Teaser Unveils Staff, Cast, July 2027 Debut
content:
The staff for the anime of author Biyori Harunohi and illustrator Yu Hitaki 's The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival ( Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyō Survival ) light novels unveiled an English-subtitled teaser promotional video and visual for the anime on Tuesday. The teaser announces the anime's main staff, its first cast member, as well as its July 2027 television premiere.

Fūka Izumi plays protagonist Alicia.

Noriyoshi Sasaki ( Ojisan to Marshmallow , Joshi Kausei , Holmes of Kyoto ) is directing the anime at Studio Clutch and Seven . Tōko Machida ( Lucky Star , The IDOLM@STER , My Master Has No Tail ) is in charge of series scripts, and Hiroyuki Miseki is designing the characters. Kohta Yamamoto , Shun Narita , and Yūki Furuhashi are composing the music.

J-Novel Club licensed the light novels, as well as Kobato Wakasa 's manga adaptation. The company describes the story:

Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she's determined to carve her own path.

Harunohi debuted the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in March 2019. The light novel version launched in April 2021, and the 11th novel volume shipped in Japan on June 15. J-Novel Club released the sixth novel volume on March 13.

Wakasa launched the manga adaptation Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyō Survival @COMIC in August 2021 on Comic Corona . The manga's ninth compiled book volume will ship in Japan on October 15. J-Novel Club released the seventh manga volume on August 12.
author: ANN

title: 'Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival' Unveils Main Staff, Cast for Summer 2027
content:
Production company Slow Curve opened an official website for the Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival ( The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival ) anime project on Tuesday, revealing the main staff, lead cast, a teaser visual (pictured), special promo, and its television format. The anime series adapting Biyori Harunohi 's adventure fantasy light novel is scheduled to premiere in July 2027.

Voice actress Fuuka Izumi ( Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete , Shikanoko Nokonoko Koshitantan ) is starring as the protagonist Alia (Alicia Melrose).

Staff Director: Noriyoshi Sasaki ( Kyoto Teramachi Sanjou no Holmes ) Series Composition: Touko Machida ( Loop 7-kaime no Akuyaku Reijou wa, Moto Tekikoku de Jiyuu Kimama na Hanayome Seikatsu wo Mankitsu suru ) Character Design: Hiroyuki Miseki ( Tadaima, Ojamasaremasu! assistant chief animation director) Music: Kohta Yamamoto ( Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season ), Shun Narita ( Noblesse ), Yuki Furuhashi ( Otome Kaijuu Caraméliser ) Studio: Studio Clutch , Seven

Harunohi began penning the series on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in March 2019. TO Books began publishing the novel in April 2021, featuring illustrations by Yuu Hitaki ( Fuguushoku "Kanteishi" ga Jitsu wa Saikyou Datta ). The eighth volume went on sale last June. The 11th volume went on sale on June 15. The light novel has a cumulative 900,000 copies of its volumes in circulation.

Comic Corona began serializing a manga adaptation by Kobato Wakasa in August 2021. TO Book published the eighth volume on January 15, with the ninth volume scheduled for release on October 15.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga adaptation in English for digital release in November 2023 and January 2024, respectively. The sixth novel volume went on sale on March 13, with the eighth manga volume scheduled to be released October 7.

title: Every New Anime Coming to HIDIVE in October 2026
content:
The Fall 2026 anime seaso n is finally here, which means all the major streaming platforms are all set for a new lineup. It’s the final quarter of the year, and fans are more hyped than ever thanks to the exciting new shows and sequels. There’s no doubt that Crunchyroll has the most exciting lineup for anyone who loves anime. The platform is primarily dedicated to anime shows and movies, which is why the lineup is vast. However, several other platforms, including HIDIVE, have been venturing into the anime industry for the past few years. Instead of releasing a new lineup every quarter as Crunchyroll does, HIDIVE focuses more on a monthly schedule.

The platform shares a new list of anime series coming and leaving the platform. Most of the time, we get ongoing series, while other times, the platform focuses on licensing new anime shows. Unlike Netflix, which has an entire library full of original shows exclusive to the platform, HIDIVE doesn’t have a long list of major shows. Even so, the October 2026 lineup is bringing a few unique titles for fans. While a few Summer 2026 series are still ongoing, the list only includes the new titles shared by the official website .

4) I’m Dating a Dark Summoner

I’m Dating a Dark Summoner is easily the wildest romance fantasy in recent years, and it already made its debut on October 4th, 2026. The anime is based on a web manga written and illustrated by Shaoh. While the series has some questionable moments, it focuses more on the enemies-to-lovers trope. The main couple has a one-night stand on the very first day they meet, which forces them to hide their awkward relationship from the rest of the adventuring party. The story primarily centers around Amona, a dark summoner and a demi-human who wields demonic powers, and Priest Roni, the newest addition to the party. Although the rest of the party expected both of them to dislike each other, the truth couldn’t be more different. Whether it’s their bickering or their hilarious moments, the series is full of chaotic situations as the main characters do everything they can to keep their relationship a secret.

3) Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden

The newest fantasy reincarnation of the season follows a little girl named Nia Liston who hides a major secret from everyone around her. The anime will premiere on October 6th, 2026, so don’t forget to catch up to this unique show. Fans will also learn about the episode count and more details on the plot after the premiere. The story begins with a young Nia lying on her deathbed as she awaits her death due to her illness. Her desperate parents began a search to find a cure for her, and they finally saw a glimmer of hope when a hooded man claims he can help her. However, the mysterious man transplants the soul of a deceased hero into her body, giving the hero a new chance at life. The hero is now determined to eliminate the illness at its root while also keeping the truth about the soul transfer a secret.

2) TETSURYO! Meet with Tetsudou Musume

Finding a good slice-of-life anime can be quite difficult these days with the oversaturation of action and fantasy shows, including Shonen and isekai. Luckily, HIDIVE is bringing just the right anime for fans who aren’t into overly thrilling shows or flashy animation, but would rather prefer a simple story about everyday lives. The anime will premiere on October 8th, although the episode count will only be revealed after it begins airing. The anime is based on a completely original story from the studio, as it centers around Misaki, a university student who is struggling with the anxiety and uncertainty of her future. She joins the Travel Train Club at the start of the new day on campus, and it doesn’t take her long to go on an adventure she always longed for. The story will follow a group of girls traveling from one place to another as they form new bonds and learn more about life that they couldn’t in the closed gates of a college campus.

1) Reincarnated As a Sword Season 2 (English Dub)

At this point, HIDIVE’s new seasonal lineup would seem incomplete without an isekai anime. After making fans wait for four years, Reincarnated As a Sword returned with a second season on September 30th, 2026. However, the anime has only been streaming in sub for now since the new lineup just confirmed that the English episodes will premiere on October 21st. Fans who have been following the series since its debut can easily tell how much the animation has improved since then, as the story continues to get even more intense. The series follows a nameless sword that has been reincarnated from his former life as a human. Thanks to the power of telekinesis, he moves around the new world while acquiring new skills. However, things change forever when a lone girl officially becomes his wielder. The latest season follows Fran and her sword as they travel to a dangerous floating island to battle an army of the dead.

Are you excited about the upcoming Fall 2026 anime? Which of these anime will you watch this month? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Netflix’s Biggest Martial Arts Anime Returns With a Wild Look Ahead of Anime’s Return
content:
The critically acclaimed sequel series of the Baki franchise returned with a brand new chapter in February this year as part of the Winter 2026 anime lineup. One of the biggest anime on Netflix is the Baki franchise, an acclaimed martial arts series based on the manga by Keisuke Itagaki. Regardless of the controversies and the wild moments in the series, there’s no denying that Baki is one of the most successful and long-standing anime and manga franchises of all time. The previous part of the story, Baki Hanma , aired two seasons before returning with Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai this year. Following the first cour of Season 1, the anime returned with new episodes with the second part in June.

The series was again a massive hit, gathering millions of views across the globe within the first few days of its release. However, Baki’s journey is far from over , and fans will get to watch even more intense battles in the future. While fans await the anime’s return, the official website drops a gorgeous new Ukiyo-e visual by illustrator KOJIMAN. The visual features the thrilling battle between Baki and Musashi, the main antagonist of the Baki-Dou series. While the anime is already available on Netflix, the visual hypes the anime’s broadcast in Japan.

What’s Next for the Baki Franchise?

While Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai only aired two cours of the anime, it covers the entire 22 volumes of the manga. The anime did suffer from some pacing issues and removal of scenes from the manga, but it remained faithful to the original story and reached a fairly conclusive end. However, the manga franchise is still ongoing thanks to new sequels which are expected to be adapted soon. It’s probably too early to decide what the future of the franchise holds, especially since the next big project is a spin-off instead of the continuation of the main story.

Around the end of August, Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaioh Doesn’t Mind Being Reincarnated in Another World At All!!! was confirmed for 2027. It’s an isekai spin-off focusing on Retsu , who wakes up in a new fantasy world after dying in his fight against Musashi Miyamoto seen in the main series. The manga is originally written by the original creator Keisuke Itagaki, while Eiji Mutusi handles the illustration. Although the anime doesn’t have a release window yet, we can expect more updates in the coming months.

Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai Wraps Up Another Major Battle

The story takes place after Baki earns the title of the World’s Strongest Boy in Baki Hanma. He spends his days in boredom waiting for a worthy opponent ever since the feud with his demon father ended. He is easily able to defend his title in Kourakuken Underground Arena while being dissatisfied with the skills of anyone he fights, which is why he hasn’t found a worthy opponent since then. However, things take a drastic turn when Musashi Miyamoto, a powerful fighter, is successfully cloned and brought to the modern era. He began challenging all famous fighting icons in Tokyo to test the limits of his own strength. Before long, Baki and Musashi come face to face as the protagonist does everything he can to defend his title as the strongest.

The previous part of the story, Baki Hanma , aired two seasons before returning with Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai this year. Following the first cour of Season 1, the anime returned with new episodes with the second part in June.

The series was again a massive hit, gathering millions of views across the globe within the first few days of its release. However, Baki’s journey is far from over , and fans will get to watch even more intense battles in the future. While fans await the anime’s return, the official website drops a gorgeous new Ukiyo-e visual by illustrator KOJIMAN. The visual features the thrilling battle between Baki and Musashi, the main antagonist of the Baki-Dou series. While the anime is already available on Netflix, the visual hypes the anime’s broadcast in Japan.
What’s Next for the Baki Franchise?

While Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai only aired two cours of the anime, it covers the entire 22 volumes of the manga. The anime did suffer from some pacing issues and removal of scenes from the manga, but it remained faithful to the original story and reached a fairly conclusive end. However, the manga franchise is still ongoing thanks to new sequels which are expected to be adapted soon. It’s probably too early to decide what the future of the franchise holds, especially since the next big project is a spin-off instead of the continuation of the main story.

Around the end of August, Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaioh Doesn’t Mind Being Reincarnated in Another World At All!!! was confirmed for 2027. It’s an isekai spin-off focusing on Retsu , who wakes up in a new fantasy world after dying in his fight against Musashi Miyamoto seen in the main series. The manga is originally written by the original creator Keisuke Itagaki, while Eiji Mutusi handles the illustration. Although the anime doesn’t have a release window yet, we can expect more updates in the coming months.
Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai Wraps Up Another Major Battle

The story takes place after Baki earns the title of the World’s Strongest Boy in Baki Hanma. He spends his days in boredom waiting for a worthy opponent ever since the feud with his demon father ended. He is easily able to defend his title in Kourakuken Underground Arena while being dissatisfied with the skills of anyone he fights, which is why he hasn’t found a worthy opponent since then. However, things take a drastic turn when Musashi Miyamoto, a powerful fighter, is successfully cloned and brought to the modern era. He began challenging all famous fighting icons in Tokyo to test the limits of his own strength. Before long, Baki and Musashi come face to face as the protagonist does everything he can to defend his title as the strongest.

title: Hideaki Anno, Yutaka Izubuchi Co-Direct 'Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199' Anime Movie
content:
An official website opened for the new Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) anime project on Tuesday, revealing its official title, main staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). Titled Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199 ( Cosmoship Yamato √2199 ), the project will be a feature-length anime movie. A premiere date has yet to be announced.

Staff Original Work: Yoshinobu Nishizaki ( Uchuu Senkan Yamato original co-creator) Director, Design Works: Hideaki Anno ( Shinseiki Evangelion ), Yutaka Izubuchi ( RahXephon ) Planning: Hideaki Anno, Mitsuhisa Ishikawa ( Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu: Die Neue These ) Executive Producer: Hideaki Anno Studio: Production I.G , Khara Production: Shin Office Academy

Hideaki Anno stated that Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199 is being developed separately and will take a different path from the remakes.

Leiji Matsumoto launched the original Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) manga in October 1974 alongside the original television anime, ending it after three volumes in December 1979. Matsumoto serialized the Shin Uchuu Senkan Yamato manga from April 2000 to April 2001. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the original manga in English and released it as an omnibus in April 2019.

Michio Murakawa began serializing the Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2199 remake in March 2012. Dark Horse Comics licensed the remake in English in January 2019 and released the second omnibus volume in March 2020.

The original Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Star Blazers: The Quest for Iscandar ) television anime aired in 26 episodes from October 1974 to March 1975, followed by the sequel anime Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2 ( Star Blazers: The Comet Empire ) from October 1978 to April 1979.

The new Uchuu Senkan Yamato ( Space Battleship Yamato ) project—rebooting the 1974 anime series—began with the Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2199 ( Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 2199 ) original video anime series that ran in 2012–2013. The Hoshimeguru Hakobune ( Odyssey of the Celestial Ark ) side story movie opened in December 2014.

The 26-episode Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2202: Ai no Senshi-tachi ( Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 2202 ) OVA ran between February 2017 and March 2019. The Seireki 2202-nen no Sentaku ( Star Blazers Chronicle 2202 ) compilation movie, reconstructing Yamato 2199 and Yamato 2202 from a new perspective, screened in June 2021.

The remake project continued with Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2205: Aratanaru Tabidachi , which released in two parts theatrically in October 2021 and February 2022.

The latest installment in the franchise, Yamato yo, Towa ni: Rebel 3199 ( Star Blazers: Space Battleship Yamato 3199 ), debuted in July 2024, served as a sequel to Aratanaru Tabidachi . Reconstructing Yamato yo Towa ni ( Be Forever Yamato ) and Uchuu Senkan Yamato III ( Star Blazers: The Bolar Wars ), the movie project will screen in seven parts for 26 episodes, with the seventh and final part scheduled to premiere on October 30.

title: Hirayasumi Manga to End in 2 More Chapters
content:
This year's 45th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga will end in two more chapters. If there are no delays, the manga will end on October 19.

Viz Media is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward. At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life. After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old woman who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin, Natsumi, moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto's easygoing lifestyle to the test.

Shinzō launched the manga in Weekly Big Comic Spirits in April 2021. Shogakukan published the manga's 10th compiled book volume on April 30, and the series has over 1.1 million copies in circulation worldwide. Viz Media released the ninth volume on May 19. The manga was nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho awards in January 2022, ranked #18 in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in December 2022, nominated for the 27th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in February 2023, and nominated for Best Continuing Manga Series in the 2nd American Manga Awards.

The manga inspired a live-action series , which premiered on NHK in November 2025.

The manga is also inspiring a television anime that will premiere in January 2027 in Japan on the NHK General channel. Viz Media announced a 2027 release in English. Viz Media is co-producing the anime with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h.

Denpa has licensed Shinzō's Holiday Junction collection of short manga. The book contains seven one-shot manga. Shogakukan shipped the book in Japan in July 2016.

title: Shonen Jump’s Latest Ending Manga Reaches Its Climax With a Twist No One Saw Coming
content:
Shonen Jump will be ending its fifth major series of 2026 very soon, but before that, it has incorporated a twist that perfectly matches the manga’s tone. 2026 has been an interesting year for Shonen Jump, with the magazine continuing its pattern of debuting new series while many are getting canceled as well. However, the interesting part was how the magazine had already confirmed at the start of the year that five major series would be coming to an end. It started with Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s sequel, Modulo , coming to an end, and in the same month, fans saw Chainsaw Man come to an end as well.

Following that was Black Clover ending its run, with the most recent being Blue Box in July. However, one major series that was still in its final fight was Sakamoto Days , which announced last July that it had entered its final battle. After Blue Box ‘s conclusion, Shonen Jump announced that the series had entered the final stage of this fight , and now, with the developments in the recent chapters, the series is indeed in its final phases. In particular, the latest chapter of Sakamoto Days , Chapter 277, “Whatever It Takes,” incorporates a comical twist that perfectly matches the tone of the series while also seemingly progressing the conclusion rapidly.

Shonen Jump’s Fifth Ending Series of 2026 Hits Its Climax With the Perfect Comical Twist

It has been a few chapters since Sakamoto entered the final fray against Slur ; however, there was still a reason needed for why the other world-class assassins who were on par with Sakamoto couldn’t defeat him, but the titular protagonist could. The reason for that has been revealed in the latest chapter, and it’s the perfect comical twist that matches what the series has presented throughout its narrative. The latest chapter features Aoi, Sakamoto’s wife, surprising him with some news, which Sakamoto initially thought was about a divorce: she is pregnant. This immediately boosts Sakamoto’s motivation, unveiling an unparalleled power as he lands a punch on Slur.

Sakamoto expresses that his main motive is seeing his daughter, Hana, become an older sister, and for this, whatever it takes, he is going to defeat Slur. This is the perfect comical yet emotional twist that matches what Sakamoto Days has always represented. It has always been about featuring the closeness of family, as Sakamoto’s presence has also infected others with the same energy. None other than the deuteragonist, Shin, is the perfect example, as he has evolved into an assassin far better than the world-class ones by learning from his master. With the latest twist, fans will get to see Shin and Sakamoto taking on Slur.

It is already easy to see where the ending is heading as well, with Sakamoto and Shin eventually teaching Slur about the notion of family and friends, making him realize that what he lost was actually everything that he wanted. Honestly, there couldn’t have been a more perfect way to wrap up this ending. With such a simple notion, Sakamoto Days has emerged as one of the biggest Shonen Jump series, running longer than even Jujutsu Kaisen , as it consistently depicts its themes, and it is nice to see that the series is doing the same with its conclusion before its ending very soon in the upcoming issues of the magazine.

title: Mackenyu Will Appear at London MCM Comic Con on October
content:
The MCM London Comic Con has announced on its X/Twitter feed that the actor Mackenyu , who plays Roronoa Zoro in the live-action One Piece webseries, will appear at the event which runs from Friday October 23 to Sunday October 25. The venue is London's ExCel Centre.

Mackenyu will appear on the Saturday and Sunday. He will participate in autograph and photo sessions ( details ), as well as a panel on the Sunday.

As well as Roronoa Zoro in the live-action One Piece webseries, Mackenyu plays Arata Wataya in the live-action Chihayafuru films, Seiya in the live-action Knights of the Zodiac film and Enishi in the live-action film Rurouni Kenshin Saishūshō The Final .

The following anime-related events are scheduled at October's MCM London Comic Con:

Friday

5 p.m. to 5.45 p.m. - "Getting Supernatural with DanDaDan" on the Live Stage, a panel featuring the dub actors A.J. Beckles (Okarun) and Kari Wahlgren (Granny Seiko).

Sunday

1.30 p.m. - Mackenyu Panel on the main stage. The panel is described as follows: "Join Mackenyu as he talks about bringing one of anime's most iconic characters to life, the training and preparation behind Zoro's legendary swordsmanship, working on the Netflix series, and his journey as an actor."

3 p.m. to 3.45 p.m. - Anime Limited Industry Panel featuring Andy Hanley and Tomi Murphy.

4 p.m. to 4.45 p.m. - Hunting Monsters with Jujutsu Kaisen on the Live Stage featuring the dub actors Anne Yatco (Nobara Kugisaki), David Vincent (Kento Nanami) and Allegra Clark (Kazumi Miwa, Maki Zenin).
